newsitem.title: USA: Atlantic Beverage expands AriZona distribution.
newsitem.headline: Atlantic Beverage expands AriZona distribution.

text.p: Atlantic Beverage Co Inc said Friday its Maryland-based beverage unit expanded its exclusive distribution rights to the AriZona beverage brand to Baltimore City and Baltimore County.
In February, Atlantic Beverage said it had acquired such rights for Washington, D.C. and the Maryland counties of Prince George's, Montgomery and Anne Arundel.
The AriZona beverage product line includes carbonated and non-carbonated flavored drinks and teas.

Over the past 18 months, Atlantic Beverage has grown significantly through acquisition of five food companies with facilities in Texas, Louisiana and Kentucky. Recently the company has expanded its Maryland-based beverage business by adding AriZona as well as the Hires, Crush, Clearly Canadian and Orbitz brands to its line of specialty beverages.

In order to accommodate this additional volume, Atlantic Beverage said it recently moved its beverage operations to a new distribution facility in Jessup, Md., which is almost twice as big as the company's previous beverage facility.
Atlantic Beverage makes, markets and distributes food products for customers in an 11-state region.
